name: Primary Sample Space Metropolis Light Transport (PSSMLT)
definition: An MCMC method where mutations are applied to random number vectors in primary sample space, which are then used to generate light paths via traditional path tracing methods, rather than sampling directly in path space.
summary: Primary Sample Space Metropolis Light Transport is a Markov Chain Monte Carlo method that mutates random number vectors in primary sample space to generate light paths, differing from traditional path space mutations by leveraging existing path tracing techniques.
